after_source: Measurement-time worktree based on baseline_commit; component provenance below. Source hashes describe that snapshot, before later PR integration.
platform: macOS arm64, non-isolated workstation, loopback client/server
conditions: No concurrent task-owned builds, tests or benchmarks during these runs.
HTTP1/2/3 and Criterion cases ran A/B/A/B; WebSocket ran three A/B pairs.
All included rounds retained; earlier overlapping-build H2 probe excluded.
Network summary is median of all round RPS; WS is median of three rates.
Criterion summary is median of two run point estimates, not request-latency percentiles.
HTTP1 uses multithread Server::spawn_http, whereas Arena uses serve_per_thread.
H3 finish tolerates RemoteTerminate(0) only; response status, body and EOF still checked.
gRPC group overrides CLI timing: 1 s warmup, 3 s measurement, 50 samples.
Compression: 1 s warmup, 2 s target, 30 samples; mixed case automatically took longer.
Compression labels 128/1024/16384 denote actual JSON lengths 140/1031/16394 bytes.
Microbenchmarks exclude network/TLS; no official Arena or gateway rerun.

provenance.http1_http3: Archived baseline HEAD and final worktree; identical harness/lockfile; all workspace crates explicitly rebuilt for each source.
provenance.http2: Baseline binary preserved before edits; final binary rebuilt after metadata correctness fixes; identical harness.
provenance.grpc: Shared-worktree builds before/after message.rs MIME fast path; other concurrent transport edits are outside direct extractor path. Not full frozen snapshots.
provenance.compression: Shared-worktree builds with HEAD vs new compression files; same core artifact 228e2e6ff8253c7c (fingerprint 2024348527227860782). Timed production paths unchanged since capture. Later bench changes only filtered-run guard and setup String::new.
provenance.ws: Shared-worktree release test builds with default,ws (Tokio); old/new socket.rs differ only in inherent send. Identical buffered echo harness; unrelated later transport edits do not execute in the timed path. Not full frozen snapshots.

pr_integration.note: The patch was rebased onto this newer main after measurement. Benchmark values and source/lockfile hashes above belong to the original measurement snapshots, not the rebased PR. No performance comparison against this newer base is claimed.
